name: pdf-workbench
description: PDF page tools, OCR, Bates and pattern redaction on the firm's shared folders. Works on copies only; nothing leaves this computer.
long_description: Runs PDF Workbench's own PDF engine on this computer. Only the folders you choose are reachable. Original files are never changed: every change works on a copy in <folder>\_workspace\<date>_<task>\ and finished files go to <folder>\Outputs\. Tools return file facts (page counts, paths, match counts), not document text. Every call is written to <folder>\_workspace\_audit\. Tools that would return document content to Claude exist only when the firm turns them on by machine policy.

folders.title: Shared folders
folders.description: The only folders Claude may use. Results go to each folder's Outputs subfolder; working copies and the audit log go to its _workspace subfolder.

app_path.title: PDF Workbench program (optional)
app_path.description: PDF Workbench.exe, used by open_in_app. Leave empty to find it in the usual install folders.

tools.name: list_pdfs
tools.description: List PDF files in the configured folders

tools.name: merge
tools.description: Combine PDFs into a new file

tools.name: split
tools.description: Split a PDF into new files

tools.name: reorder
tools.description: Put pages in a new order

tools.name: extract_pages
tools.description: Copy pages into a new file

tools.name: redact_patterns
tools.description: Redact SSNs, EINs and account numbers; returns counts only

tools.name: open_in_app
tools.description: Open a file at a page in PDF Workbench
